notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes: New update for Pawn Shop: Simulator! We've revamped the game's color scheme for a more uniform look, improved post-processing, fixed several bugs, and added a leveling system to enhance gameplay!

notes.title: Language support update.
notes.notes:
In today's update:
- New language has been added to the game: "Cantonese"

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
In today patch:
- Bug with second shop has been fixed
- Added new options in settings (Audio and VSYNC)
- Clients now will come with receipt of their product
- Tutorial has been reworked
